title: A Companion to the Forked Arc
summary: A companion for students past the courses that splits one arc into many prongs, branching bolts and a net of charge.

title: A Treatise on the Heavy Fist
summary: A treatise on charged blows that rely on body weight and stored shock to break guards and split hard targets.

title: Canon of the Living Field
summary: A canon of charge that leaves the body and circulates around it as a living field that senses, guards, strikes and snares.

title: Treatise on the Ozone Veil
summary: Teaches a veil of charged air around the user that hides, blinds and turns aside blows before they land.

title: Twin-Court Manual of the Paired Bolts
summary: A paired manual of two bolts cast in step, one from each hand, that land together on one mark.

title: Hawk-Cry Canon of the Basin Thunder
summary: Teaches thunder timed to a hawk-like cry that startles the foe before a diving charged strike.

title: Book of the River of Charge
summary: Treats charge as a river that runs through the user's field, with lashes, eddies and a long flowing bolt.

title: Oath-Book of the Sworn Peal
summary: A wind-sworn oath-book in which each peal of thunder is sworn to a bearing and held until it is loosed.

title: Plateau Canon of the True Line
summary: Teaches a bolt sent along one held bearing, from the first line through to the long unbent shot.

title: Treatise on the Unwalled Thunder
summary: Trains thunder with no guard held back, the whole body open and loosing charge in every direction.
